description: This file is a server entry point for handling HTTP requests in a Remix-based web application, specifically implementing server-side rendering with streaming responses, bot detection, and CORS configuration.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function handling incoming requests and dispatching to bot or browser-specific handlers based on user-agent.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering stream for bot requests, providing a SSR stream to clients like crawlers.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering stream for browser requests, enabling hydration and interactivity.
